shape.rule: psd = the mean periodic-Hann periodogram |rfft(w x)|^2 / sum w^2 (hop n_fft/2) of n_mc unit-RMS wind_sc.wind_noise clips of clip_s at this law, divided by its mean over ref_band_hz (= unit_psd_ref); the renderer scales a unit-RMS draw by sqrt(10^{level_db/10} / unit_psd_ref), so its expected PSD is 10^{level_db/10} psd

wind.level: level_db[m] is 10 log10 of capsule m's expected wind PSD averaged over shape.ref_band_hz (20-100 Hz), in the model's periodogram units (the static wind_db's on its flat part), before the array response; one independent SC draw per capsule

frozen.profiles: profile_aero_db[:, :10] free (N(centre, 6 dB)); the orders above and profile_motor_db the source's
frozen.mic_response: pair EQ frozen up to the per-mic gain: pair_eq.db[:, m, :] = bench + h_m
frozen.rule: L_r rendered per frame by LineRenderer (the torch port of the line part of v4.expected_periodogram) at the free profiles and phase pedestal of k <= 10 and the free eps

coherence.coordinates: u_s2P, u_W: bench_v4._capped under PHASE_SIGMA2_MAX / W_MAX_HZ; log eps
coherence.why: the alternating DREGON flight fit: the lines refit on flight data (the low orders k <= 10 carry the flight line energy: per-rotor profile entries, their phase pedestal and the shaft eps), with the source's wind shape held

start.rule: the bench pedestal (sigma2_phase, width_phase_hz, k <= 10) clamped to at most 0.99 of its cap, and the bench eps

bench.rule: the stage source's pedestal and eps

coherence.export: params.pedestal.{sigma2_phase, gamma_phase_hz, width_phase_hz} and params.shaft.eps replaced; pedestal.held_by_evidence dropped

wind.rule: the source's sc block, its gust law and shape held, level_db refitted

mic_gain.export: mic_response.pair_eq.db[:, m, :] += h_m (lines and per-rotor floor on mic m)

flight_stage.band_rule: the source payload's band_hz: the bench Whittle's band (bench_v4.BAND_HZ)

pool.units: |rfft(w x)|^2 / sum w^2, one-sided; no channel gains

start.floor_rule: per band bin: quantile FLOOR_INIT_QUANTILE (+ FLOOR_INIT_DB_CORRECTION) over mics and frames of max(I - L - W0, 0.1 I) / sum_r h_rm s_rn^b at the bench b; least squares on the controls; z the bench's ridge solve
start.values: the flight source's floor, static share and wind levels (the floor and wind centres as recorded here)

floor_mean.rule: bench_v4 floor-mean prior; centre the mean of the floor measured on this pool

priors.floor_z: N(0, I); control values mean_db + shape_sd_db (L z)

wind.rule: N(source level, wind_db_sd): the flight source's own per-mic wind levels
wind.shape: the source sc wind's shape (its gust law's long-run PSD), held

priors.floor_push: +kappa sum_j ctrl_j on the log prior (dB)

mic_gain.constraint: sum_m h_m = 0 (free h_1..h_{M-1}, h_M = -sum): the common level is g_r's
mic_gain.rule: per mic, on every rotor's lines and the per-rotor floor (a pair-EQ change); flight vs bench per-mic level, on the scale of nv3r4's per-mic level spread

phase_pedestal.rule: bench_v4.phase_pedestal_neg_log_prior in the capped coordinates (bench_v4._capped), per aerodynamic order k <= 10 (the free orders)

profile.rule: per rotor and aerodynamic order, centred on the bench value; the line gain's 6 dB bench -> flight level scale

sigma_ref.rule: v4_priors.FLIGHT_SIGMA_NU_LN (flight sigma_nu at f_ref, rad/s; flight_v4's sigma_ref) on sigma_ref = 2 pi f_ref eps, the DREGON sigma_nu at the payload's f_ref; a_sigma, lam_ref and b_lam held at the bench's

convergence.test: a fresh-memory pass after the first (any pass of a continuation), not cut by the deadline: gain per cell < tol AND every group's movement < its tolerance (max; the per-order pedestal groups by their median)

shape.level: wind_db[m] is 10 log10 of W_m(f) on the flat part (f <= corner), in the model's periodogram units; W_m is static (no speed law, no channel gain) and is added to the floor

wind_stage.frozen: every params block but wind: the source payload's (lines, floor, per-rotor and per-mic gains, coherence)

targets.envelope: experiments.stochastic_fit.diagnostics.floor_envelope, floor cells of 50-500 Hz (+-5 Hz around every k r excluded)
targets.thrust_regression: per mic OLS of the envelope on [1, the same mic's 1000-4000 Hz band level in dB], residual re its median (real and simulated alike)
targets.spectrum: mean floor-cell power per third-octave band over every frame and cell, dB

scales.rule: across-segment sd (ddof 1) of each statistic, the per-capsule ones pooled over the mics as the root-mean variance, the spectrum per band; floored at the floors (one segment: the floors alone)

fit.search: 1 dB scan over centre +-30 dB, bounded Brent on the bracket
fit.rule: E = E0 + 10^{L/10} T, E0 the source payload's expected periodogram without its wind, T the sc wind at 0 dB (window transform x array response); composite Whittle risk on the flight stage pool and band, plus the prior; per mic

pool.units: |rfft(w x)|^2 / sum w^2, one-sided; no channel gains

gust_law.seed_rule: segment i, seed k: base render seed base_seed + 100 i + k, sim wind seed wind_seed + 100 i + k, the same at every grid point (common random numbers)
gust_law.distance_rule: sum over segments of ((sim - real) / scale)^2: each per-capsule statistic summed over the mics, xmic_corr x M, the spectrum as the mean over its bands per mic summed over the mics; sim = the seed average

renderer_check.rule: render_v4_wind (the renderer's wind path: its own stream of each seed, the array response and the anti-alias) of n_seeds clips; mean periodic-Hann periodogram vs 10^{level_db/10} shape.psd x 10^{A_m/10}, third-octave band power inside band_hz, max |error| over mics and bands < tol_db

line_block_swap.rule: the converged bench fit c7's line block (profiles, motor family, speed exponents, hierarchy, pedestal, shaft, pair EQ) with the C-wind payload's flight floor, static share and SC wind; the start of the alternating flight fit. The floor and wind were fitted under the s2 lines and are refitted with the lines.
